verified_claims.claim: ALE 56天后H和DH条件H2O2耐受度分别提高5.6倍和21.9倍
verified_claims.evidence: By the end of 56 days, the H2O2 concentration tolerance was increased by 5.6-fold and 21.9-fold, at H and DH conditions, respectively (Fig. 2C).

verified_claims.claim: E_LRS5 紫杉二烯、iso-taxadiene、GGOH滴度分别为103.3 ± 15.2、4.00 ± 3.4、11.8 ± 2.3 mg/L，对应2.9/1.7/3.3倍提升
verified_claims.evidence: The overall taxadiene, iso-taxadiene and GGOH titres by E_LRS5 were 103.3 ± 15.2, 4.00 ± 3.4 and 11.8 ± 2.3 mg/L, which represented a 2.9- (adjusted p = 0.005), 1.7- (adjusted p = 0.001), and 3.3-fold (adjusted p = 0.001) improvement compared to the original LRS5.

verified_claims.claim: 1%半乳糖下LRS5与E_LRS5最大比生长速率分别为0.12 ± 0.01与0.24 ± 0.01 h⁻¹，恒化器稀释率选0.1 h⁻¹
verified_claims.evidence: Maximum growth rates (μmax) of 0.12 ± 0.01 for LRS5 and 0.24 ± 0.01 h−1 for E_LRS5 were achieved under 1% galactose addition, therefore our subsequent chemostat experiments were performed at a dilution rate of 0.1 h−1.
the major contributor to the overflow metabolites was ethanol (SSI–SSII, LRS5: 23.3 ± 1.90 % and 25 ± 0.61 %, E_LRS5: 16.5 ± 1.21 % and 17.4 ± 1.32 %)

verified_claims.claim: E_LRS5 vs LRS5 RQ SSI下1.25 ± 0.04 vs 1.48 ± 0.07 (adjusted p = 0.004)，SSII 1.48 ± 0.06 (LRS5) vs 1.32 ± 0.05 (E_LRS5) (adjusted p = 0.039)
verified_claims.evidence: E_LRS5 depicted a higher respiratory capacity with a 1.2-fold lower RQ value (1.25 ± 0.04 vs. 1.48 ± 0.07; adjusted p = 0.004)…similar values at SSII, 1.48 ± 0.06 (LRS5) and 1.32 ± 0.05 (E_LRS5) (adjusted p = 0.039)

verified_claims.claim: 进化单独引发1607个上调与1675个下调基因；氧化应激仅176/455；交互作用223/106
verified_claims.evidence: at cut-off of log2 fold change (LFC) = 0 and FDR <0.05, 1607 and 1675 genes were found to be up- and downregulated, respectively, by evolution…The number of upregulated and downregulated genes remarkably decreased to 176 and 455, and 223 and 106 for oxidative stress and interaction factors

verified_claims.claim: E_LRS5半乳糖摄取率较LRS5降低1.2倍至1.66 ± 0.2 mmol/gDW/h (adjusted p = 0.038)
verified_claims.evidence: 1.2-fold lower galactose consumption rate in E_LRS5 (1.66 ± 0.2 mmol/gDW/h; adjusted p = 0.038)

verified_claims.claim: Leloir途径基因GAL1, GAL2, GAL3, GAL7, GAL10, GAL11, GAL80整体下调
verified_claims.evidence: we noticed the general downregulation of the Leloir pathway genes and regulators and reaction fluxes (GAL1, GAL2, GAL3, GAL7, GAL10, GAL11 and GAL80)

verified_claims.claim: 亲水蛋白SIP18 (LFC 3.17), GRE1 (LFC 1.91), STF2 (LFC 0.54)在进化单独项显著上调
verified_claims.evidence: hydrophilin genes (induced under the dehydration stress) (SIP18; LFC: 3.17, STF2; LFC: 0.54, GRE1; LFC: 1.91) were strongly upregulated by evolution.

verified_claims.claim: HEM2, HEM3, HEM4 and HEM12在进化单独项下整体上调
verified_claims.evidence: with enzymes involved in synthesising the intermediates to heme b synthesis were all upregulated (Fig. 5B). Similar to the metabolic shift from fermentation to respiration that induces the HAP transcription factor…HEM2, 3 and 12 genes
